title: Incorrect Loop Boundary
task: Calculate and print the sum of every number in the list passed to calculate_sum.
cause: The loop stops before processing the last element due to len(numbers) - 1.
hint: Check the upper limit of the range function.

title: Unterminated Statement
task: Store the count as an integer and print it with the label Count is.
cause: The variable declaration statement is missing a terminating semicolon.
hint: In C, every statement must end with a delimiter.

title: Unclosed Print Call
task: Print the text stored in message.
code:
message = "System Ready"
print(message
cause: The print function call is missing its closing parenthesis.
hint: Check whether every opening parenthesis has a closing partner.

title: Missing Colon in Header
task: Return Positive for numbers greater than zero and Non-positive otherwise; print the result for the supplied number.
code:
def check_positive(num):
    if num > 0
        return "Positive"
    return "Non-positive"

print(check_positive(5))
cause: The if statement is missing a trailing colon (:).
hint: Python control statements require a colon at the end of the line.

title: Missing Decimal Places
task: Print the stored score with exactly one digit after the decimal point, keeping the Score: label.
cause: The zero precision in %.0f rounds the score to zero decimal places when printing.
hint: The number after the dot in the format controls the decimal places.

title: Assignment in a Condition
task: Print ZERO when number is zero and NOT ZERO otherwise, without changing number.
cause: A single equals sign assigns zero to number; the condition therefore evaluates as false.
hint: Assignment and equality use different operators.

title: Total Reset Inside a Loop
task: Add all the values in numbers and print their total.
code:
numbers = [2, 3, 4]
total = 0
for number in numbers:
    total = number
print(total)
cause: Assignment overwrites total on every iteration instead of accumulating the numbers.
hint: Track the value of total after each iteration.

title: Last Array Element Skipped
task: Sum all five elements of arr and print the total with the Sum: label.
cause: The loop stops before index four, so the final array element is excluded from the sum.
hint: An array with five elements uses indices zero through four.

title: Integer Division Before Assignment
task: Calculate the mean value for count readings whose combined value is total, preserving its fractional part; print it to one decimal place.
cause: Both operands are integers, so division discards the fractional part before assignment to average.
hint: The type on the left does not change how the expression on the right is evaluated.

title: Type Mismatch on User Input
task: Treat user_val as text containing an integer, double its numeric value, and print the result.
code:
def double_value(user_val):
    return user_val * 2

# User enters numeric string '15'
result = double_value("15")
print(result)
cause: Multiplying a string by 2 duplicates the string ("1515") instead of performing arithmetic.
hint: String multiplication in Python repeats the text.

title: Printing the Wrong Variable
task: Print the person's age with the Age: label, using the variables as declared.
cause: The printf argument is year instead of age, so it prints the wrong variable.
hint: Compare the label in the output with the variable passed to printf.

title: Index Beyond the List
task: Print the last element of numbers without changing the list.
code:
numbers = [10, 20, 30]
print(numbers[3])
cause: Index three is outside this three-element list; the last valid index is two, causing IndexError.
hint: The first element is at index zero.

title: Adding Instead of Multiplying
task: Build and print a list in which each item is multiplied by multiplier.
code:
multiplier = 10
items = [1, 2, 3]
result = [item + multiplier for item in items]
print(result)
cause: The plus operator adds the multiplier to each item instead of multiplying them.
correction: result = [item * multiplier for item in items]
hint: Check the operator used between item and multiplier.

title: Missing Break in Switch Statement
task: Print exactly one status: SUCCESS for code 0, ERROR for code 1, or DONE for any other code.
cause: Missing 'break;' in case 0 causes fallthrough into case 1, printing two statuses.
hint: Cases in C switch statements fall through unless explicitly terminated.

title: Method Never Called
task: Convert name to uppercase and print the converted text.
code:
name = "alice"
print(name.upper)
cause: Referencing the upper method without parentheses does not call it to convert the name.
hint: A method reference and a method call are different.

title: Dictionary Key Mutation
task: Store val in the scores dictionary under the key supplied by student, then print the dictionary.
cause: Attempting attribute assignment 'scores.student' on a dictionary raises AttributeError.
hint: Python dictionaries use subscript square-bracket syntax for keys.

title: Function Result Ignored
task: Store the value returned by add in result and print it with the Result: label.
cause: The returned value from add is discarded, so result remains zero.
hint: Calling a function does not automatically store its return value.

title: Return Too Early
task: Return the sum of every number passed to total, then print that sum.
cause: The return statement is inside the loop, so the function exits after the first element.
hint: Look at the indentation of the return statement.

title: Missing Return Value
task: Return the square of number from square and print the returned value.
cause: The function calculates an expression but has no return statement, so it returns None.
hint: How does a function pass its result back to the caller?

title: Changing the Wrong Character
task: Change only the first character of word to uppercase H, then print the whole word.
cause: Index one selects the second character; the first character is at index zero.
hint: String indices start at zero in C.

title: Pass Mark Excluded
task: Print PASS for a score of 50 or higher and FAIL for a lower score.
cause: The strict greater-than condition excludes a score equal to the pass mark of fifty.
hint: A score exactly equal to the pass mark should pass.

title: Missing Fallback Return
task: parse_int must return the parsed integer, or zero if the text is invalid. Add five to its return value and print the result.
cause: 'pass' in the except block causes parse_int to implicitly return None, and 'None + 5' raises TypeError.
hint: A function that falls off the end without return produces None.

title: Incorrect Digit Accumulator
task: Calculate and print the sum of the decimal digits of the positive integer number. Keep processing digits until number is zero.
cause: Integer division removes the last digit rather than extracting it for the total.
hint: Which operation gives the last decimal digit of a positive integer?

title: Losing the Sorted List
task: Sort scores in ascending order in place, then print scores as a list. Do not replace the list with hardcoded values.
code:
scores = [30, 10, 20]
scores = scores.sort()
print(scores)
cause: list.sort changes the list in place and returns None, so assigning its return value loses the list reference.
hint: Does list.sort return a sorted list, or modify the existing list?

title: Two Names for One List
task: Make backup an independent copy of original. Changing backup must leave original unchanged; print original's first element.
code:
original = [1, 2, 3]
backup = original
backup[0] = 99
print(original[0])
cause: Assignment makes backup and original refer to the same list, so mutation changes both views.
hint: Does assigning a list create a new list?

title: Wrong Return Branch
task: larger must return the greater of its two integer arguments. Print its result for the supplied call without changing the arguments.
cause: The fallback branch returns a even when b is greater than a.
hint: When the condition is false, which argument should be returned?

title: Even Test Reversed
task: Print EVEN for an even positive integer and ODD for an odd positive integer.
cause: The condition tests for remainder one, which identifies odd positive numbers instead of even numbers.
hint: An even number divides by two without a remainder.

title: Adding Text Instead of Numbers
task: Treat first and second as text containing integers and print their numeric sum.
code:
first = "2"
second = "3"
print(first + second)
cause: Both values are strings, so the plus operator concatenates text instead of adding numbers.
hint: Look at the types of first and second.

title: Empty Loop Body
task: Print GO on its own line three times, once for each iteration of the loop.
cause: The semicolon creates an empty loop body; the following block executes only once after the loop.
hint: Check the character immediately after the closing parenthesis of for.

title: Range Check Always True
task: Print INSIDE only for numbers from 1 through 10 inclusive; print OUTSIDE for all other numbers.
cause: Logical OR accepts either comparison, so number fifteen passes the lower bound even though it exceeds ten.
hint: To be in a range, must one condition hold or must both hold?
